study_and_primary_citation: Chen MM et al., Cancer Cell 2025;43:1656-1676.e10. doi:10.1016/j.ccell.2025.06.020
material_and_units: 21 coordinate-resolved human PDAC sections from 18 patients
inclusion_rule: All 21 available in-tissue sections; per-section DC-core-above-mean mask; repeated sections collapsed to patient medians
key_exclusion_or_interpretive_boundary: Spot-level program analysis; no cell identity, cell contact, TLS morphology, mechanism, prognosis or treatment inference

study_and_primary_citation: Sidiropoulos DN et al., Cancer Immunol Res 2025;13:1716-1731. doi:10.1158/2326-6066.CIR-25-0387
material_and_units: Tumour-designated PDAC surgical-specimen packages; 8 FFPE and 10 frozen in main set
inclusion_rule: Complete nested archive, coordinate/barcode match, in-tissue spots, tumour designation and primary-program scoreability; 18 packages retained
key_exclusion_or_interpretive_boundary: Public patient identifiers unavailable, so not patient-level clinical validation; neoadjuvant-treatment context limits generalizability; three low-detection frozen packages are sensitivity-only
citation_status: Cited in manuscript; platform independently checked against GEO family SOFT

material_and_units: Eight fresh-frozen sections; GEO describes spatial transcriptomics with pathology-transferred regional annotations
inclusion_rule: Not used in locked coordinate-resolved primary endpoint

inclusion_rule: Used only for contextual program/marker assessment
key_exclusion_or_interpretive_boundary: Targeted panel and segmented-cell design are not an independent patient-level confirmation of the locked spot-level endpoint

GEO_platform_or_assay: GPL24676; 10x Genomics scRNA-seq; GEO subseries of GSE217847
material_and_units: Ten human resected PDAC tumour scRNA-seq matrices (GSM6727542-GSM6727551) in GSE217847_RAW.tar
analysis_role: Supplementary gene-detectability and marker-gating feasibility QC
inclusion_rule: All ten GEO-designated primary-tumour samples; matrices traced by GSM accession within the parent-series archive
